articles.title: Scientists Sent a Robot 3 Miles Below the Ocean—What It Found Is a Warning
articles.summary: Scientists have uncovered significant evidence of the human footprint thousands of feet below the ocean's surface, hundreds of miles from shore. A research team exploring the deep sea found proof of human impact even in these remote environments. This discovery highlights the pervasive extent of human influence on global ecosystems, underscoring the critical need for environmental awareness and preservation efforts, even in the planet's most inaccessible regions.
